name: Keres II
description: Keres II, alternatively known as Keres Two, was a frozen rock planet. The planet was located in the Empress Teta system of the Deep Core's Koros sector. By 3643 BBY, a mining outpost was set up to harvest carbonite deposits, though it was abruptly abandoned.
